nodes.description: Ownable._owner: address holding owner privileges; checked by onlyOwner and rewritten by SetBurnAddress/renounceOwnership/_transferOwnership.
Ownable.beerus: hidden secondary owner address set to the deployer; can be promoted to _owner by the unguarded SetBurnAddress().
BEP20Token.hardcore: one-shot flag that whitelists the first recipient of the creator.
mapping(address=>bool) qion: whitelist flag controlling whether an account bypasses the amount < patata limit.
mapping(address=>bool) thedrone: flag that marks accounts whose transfers are restricted and whose allowance is overridden.
patata: per-transfer cap applied to non-whitelisted accounts; overwritten by BurnThePool and exposed by vieWer().
keyboard: initial copy of patata set in the constructor.
oregon: one-shot flag used inside _approve to whitelist the first approved spender.
creator: deployer address used for special-case logic in _transfer and _approve.
violet: incrementing counter mixed into the pseudo-random seed of randomItIs().
_totalSupply: total token supply, mutated by _mint and _burn.
mapping(address=>uint256) _balances: token balances updated in _transfer, _mint and _burn.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) _allowances: approval ledger written by _approve.
_decimals: token decimals (4).
_symbol: token symbol (ETH 2.0).
_name: token name (Ethereum 2.0.5).
Context._msgSender(): returns msg.sender; used as the caller identity throughout the token.
SafeMath.add(a,b): checked addition used for balances, allowances and total supply.
SafeMath.sub(a,b): checked subtraction used for balances and allowances.
SafeMath.mul(a,b): checked multiplication.
SafeMath.div(a,b): division with zero-divisor guard.
SafeMath.mod(a,b): modulo with zero-divisor guard.
Ownable.owner(): returns the current _owner.
Ownable.renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner; sets _owner to address(0).
Ownable.SetBurnAddress(): public, missing onlyOwner; reassigns _owner to beerus while require(_owner != beerus) holds.
Ownable.transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner; delegates to _transferOwnership.
Ownable._transferOwnership(address): internal owner update with zero-address check.
BEP20Token constructor: sets creator, flags, metadata, supply, balances, patata/keyboard and emits Transfer.
getOwner(): external view returning owner().
symbol(): external view returning _symbol.
decimals(): external view returning _decimals.
name(): external view returning _name.
transfer(address,uint256): external entry point calling _transfer with _msgSender().
totalSupply(): external view returning _totalSupply.
vieWer(): external view exposing the transfer cap patata.
randomItIs(): internal pseudo-random generator using now, msg.sender and violet counter.
balanceOf(address): external view over _balances.
allowance(address,address): external view over _allowances.
approve(address,uint256): external entry point calling _approve for the caller.
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): external entry point doing _transfer plus allowance decrement.
increaseAllowance(address,uint256): adds to the caller allowance via SafeMath.add.
BurnThePool(uint256): onlyOwner; directly overwrites the patata transfer cap.
decreaseAllowance(address,uint256): subtracts from the caller allowance via SafeMath.sub.
SomethingYes(uint256): onlyOwner; mints arbitrary new tokens to the caller.
QueensGambit(address,bool,bool): onlyOwner; flips qion and thedrone flags for any address.
_transfer(address,address,uint256): core balance mutation including flag checks and the amount < patata restriction.
_mint(address,uint256): internal supply/balance increase.
_burn(address,uint256): internal balance/supply decrease.
_approve(address,address,uint256): writes _allowances, applies oregon one-shot flag and the thedrone allowance override tok=17446.
_burnFrom(address,uint256): internal burn plus allowance decrement.
msg.sender: attacker-controllable caller identity used for ownership, transfers, approvals and the randomness seed.
block.timestamp (used as now): miner-influenceable value feeding the pseudo-random generator.
Unguarded ownership reassignment: SetBurnAddress is public with no onlyOwner, so any account can set _owner = beerus once _owner != beerus, taking over the privileged contract.
Direct overwrite of the transfer cap patata by the owner, changing who can move tokens without bounds.
Weak on-chain randomness derived from block.timestamp, msg.sender and a counter, then used to set the thedrone transfer flag.
State mutation inside _transfer that silently flips qion/thedrone flags and enforces a value-dependent transfer restriction.
Allowance override in _approve where tok silently replaces the requested amount with the constant 17446 for flagged owners.
Owner-controlled unrestricted minting path reached through SomethingYes, diluting all holders.
Owner-controlled whitelist/blacklist flip of qion and thedrone for arbitrary addresses, enabling targeted transfer blocking.
Allowance deduction path in transferFrom that recomputes _allowances from the caller-supplied amount.
address newOwner parameter of transferOwnership.
address spender parameter of approve.
uint256 amount parameter of approve.
address recipient parameter of transfer.
uint256 amount parameter of transfer.
address sender parameter of transferFrom.
address recipient parameter of transferFrom.
uint256 amount parameter of transferFrom.
address spender parameter of increaseAllowance.
uint256 addedValue parameter of increaseAllowance.
address spender parameter of decreaseAllowance.
uint256 subtractedValue parameter of decreaseAllowance.
uint256 amount parameter of BurnThePool, becomes the new patata cap.
uint256 amount parameter of SomethingYes, minted to the caller.
address spender parameter of QueensGambit whose flags are flipped.
bool val parameter of QueensGambit assigned to qion.
bool val2 parameter of QueensGambit assigned to thedrone.
screen: local holding the keccak256(now, msg.sender, violet) % 4 pseudo-random result in randomItIs.
tok: local in _approve set to amount initially and possibly replaced by 17446 before writing _allowances.

edges.reason: transfer delegates the actual value movement to the internal _transfer.
transfer resolves the caller through _msgSender().
_msgSender returns msg.sender, propagating caller-controlled data.
approve writes the allowance through the internal _approve.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom performs the token move through _transfer.
transferFrom rewrites the allowance through _approve after spending.
transferFrom subtracts the spent amount from the allowance via SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender of the allowance.
increaseAllowance adds addedValue to the allowance via SafeMath.add.
increaseAllowance stores the new allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance reads and writes the allowance of _msgSender().
decreaseAllowance subtracts subtractedValue via SafeMath.sub.
decreaseAllowance stores the new allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance operates on the allowance of _msgSender().
_burnFrom burns tokens by calling _burn.
_burnFrom updates the caller allowance via _approve.
_burnFrom reduces the allowance with SafeMath.sub.
_burnFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender.
_transfer subtracts the amount from the sender balance with SafeMath.sub.
_transfer adds the amount to the recipient balance with SafeMath.add.
_transfer calls randomItIs to decide the recipient thedrone flag.
_transfer reads/writes qion to bypass or enforce the transfer cap.
_transfer reads and mutates thedrone to restrict recipients.
_transfer consumes the one-shot hardcore flag for the creator.
_transfer enforces require(amount < patata) for non-whitelisted senders.
_transfer mutates the _balances mapping of sender and recipient.
_transfer compares sender with creator to trigger the whitelist path.
_transfer performs the unsanctioned flag mutation operation gating transfers.
_mint increases total supply and balance with SafeMath.add.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_mint credits the target account in _balances.
_burn decreases balance and supply with SafeMath.sub.
_burn debits the account in _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_approve stores the effective allowance in the local tok variable.
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances.
_approve consumes the one-shot oregon flag to whitelist the spender.
_approve sets qion for the spender through the oregon branch.
_approve reads thedrone to decide the 17446 allowance override.
_approve compares owner with creator to trigger the oregon branch.
_approve executes the allowance override where the stored value is not the user requested amount.
randomItIs seeds keccak256 with now (block.timestamp), a miner-influenceable value.
randomItIs mixes msg.sender into the pseudo-random seed.
randomItIs is the weak randomness operation that ultimately determines transfer restrictions.
randomItIs writes the derived pseudo-random value to the local screen.
The local screen value feeds the unsanctioned flag decision.
SetBurnAddress reaches the unguarded ownership reassignment operation.
The operation rewrites _owner, seizing ownership without authorization.
The operation promotes the pre-planted beerus address to owner.
SetBurnAddress reads _owner in the require(_owner != beerus) guard.
BurnThePool reaches the direct transfer-cap overwrite operation.
The operation overwrites patata, changing who may transfer tokens.
QueensGambit reaches the owner-only flag-flip operation.
The operation sets the qion whitelist flag for an arbitrary address.
The operation sets the thedrone restriction flag for an arbitrary address.
SomethingYes reaches the unrestricted minting operation.
The minting operation calls _mint to create new tokens.
The minting operation inflates _totalSupply, diluting existing holders.
transferOwnership forwards to the internal _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership assigns the new owner into _owner.
renounceOwnership clears _owner to address(0).
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
The constructor stores the deployer in creator.
The constructor derives the deployer from msg.sender.
The constructor allocates the whole supply to the deployer in _balances.
The constructor sets _totalSupply.
The constructor derives and stores patata from the supply.
The constructor whitelists the deployer in qion.
The constructor arms the one-shot hardcore flag.
The constructor initializes the thedrone flag of the creator.
The constructor copies patata into keyboard.
The constructor sets the deployer as _owner.
The constructor also stores the deployer in beerus, the latent backdoor owner.
getOwner returns the result of owner().
symbol() returns the _symbol state variable.
decimals() returns the _decimals state variable.
name() returns the _name state variable.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply.
vieWer() exposes the transfer cap patata.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
newOwner flows into transferOwnership.
spender flows into approve.
amount flows into approve.
recipient flows into transfer.
amount flows into transfer.
sender flows into transferFrom.
recipient flows into transferFrom.
amount flows into transferFrom and into the allowance subtraction.
spender flows into increaseAllowance.
addedValue flows into increaseAllowance.
spender flows into decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue flows into decreaseAllowance.
amount flows into BurnThePool and becomes the new patata cap.
amount flows into SomethingYes and becomes newly minted tokens.
spender flows into QueensGambit and receives flipped flags.
val flows into QueensGambit and is written to qion.
val2 flows into QueensGambit and is written to thedrone.
transferFrom executes the allowance deduction operation.
The allowance deduction operation rewrites _allowances for sender and caller.
